headline: London Copper Steadies After Overnight Rout Amid Tariff Pressures
summary: Benchmark three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange rose 0.52% to $11,887.50 a metric ton, stabilizing after an overnight sell-off driven by tariff fears.
why: London Metal Exchange copper prices serve as a global economic health indicator and respond directly to industrial demand and trade policy shifts.
why_moved: Fresh trade tension and tariff announcements create volatile swings in industrial metals demand expectations.
